How credit-building cards work
Set your credit limit.
Your card limit is the same amount as your refundable security deposit. It's held in a secured savings account with U.S. Bank.
Use your card for everyday purchases.
Use your card wherever credit cards are accepted. It works just like a traditional credit card, and it looks the same, too – merchants can’t tell the difference between a secured card and traditional card.
Build your credit.
We monitor your activity and regularly report your card status to the three major credit bureaus. Spend within your limit and pay your bill when it’s due. Over time, this will help build your credit.

Common questions about the U.S. Bank Secured Card
What is the best secured credit card for building credit?
The U.S. Bank Secured Visa® Card is designed for people who want to build or re-establish their credit history. The card reports account activity to the three major credit bureaus, helping cardholders build credit through responsible use over time.
How does the U.S. Bank Secured Visa® Card help build credit?
The U.S. Bank Secured Visa® Card regularly reports account activity to the three major credit bureaus. Making payments on time and staying within your credit limit can help establish or strengthen your credit history.
What security deposit is required for the U.S. Bank Secured Visa® Card?
The card requires a refundable security deposit between $300 and $5,000. The amount of the deposit becomes the card's credit limit and is held in a U.S. Bank secured savings account.
What credit score is needed for the U.S. Bank Secured Visa® Card?
U.S. Bank secured credit card products are designed for people looking to build or rebuild credit with responsible use. These products can help individuals who have limited credit history or who are working to improve their credit.1
Does the U.S. Bank Secured Visa® Card have an annual fee?
No. The U.S. Bank Secured Visa® Card has a $ annual fee, allowing cardholders to focus on building credit without paying an annual fee.
Can I check my credit score with the U.S. Bank Secured Visa® Card?
Yes. Cardholders can view their credit score through the U.S. Bank Mobile App or online banking.
Is the U.S. Bank Secured Visa® Card good for everyday purchases?
Yes. Everyday purchases combined with responsible repayment habits can help support credit-building goals.1
What happens to the security deposit on the U.S. Bank Secured Visa® Card?
The security deposit is held in a U.S. Bank secured savings account. The deposit will not be used as long as the account remains open and in good standing and may be returned if the account is upgraded or closed.
What security features does the U.S. Bank Secured Visa® Card offer?
The card includes Zero Fraud Liability, meaning cardholders are not responsible for unauthorized transactions if the card is lost or stolen. The card also supports contactless payments and mobile wallet functionality.
Who should consider the U.S. Bank Secured Visa® Card?
The U.S. Bank Secured Visa® Card may be a good option for people looking to build credit. The card provides a way to establish a credit history while accessing the convenience of a Visa credit card.1
